name: How long does a typical roof wear-and-tear assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical roof wear-and-tear assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a typical roof wear-and-tear assessment can vary depending on the size and complexity of your roof, but it generally takes between 30 minutes to 2 hours. Factors such as roof accessibility, pitch, and the extent of visible damage can influence the time required. Our team aims for efficiency while ensuring a thorough examination, providing you with a timely and comprehensive report.
acceptedAnswer.description: A roof wear-and-tear assessment typically takes 30 minutes to 2 hours, varying by roof size, complexity, and accessibility.
